title: Adversarial Findings Envelope
description: Reconciled output of the adversarial-verification-council mode (subagent-orchestration Mode 9). A model-diverse skeptic panel red-teams a real, already-verified change; each skeptic returns findings; reconciliation (src/scripts/_lib/adversarial_reconcile.ts) dedups them into this envelope with per-finding provenance and a cross-model confidence signal. ADVISORY ONLY — never gates a change (Hard Floor). Hand-validated by adversarial_reconcile.test.ts (no jsonschema runtime dep).

models.description: Distinct model ids of the skeptics. For the registered claim + high-risk tier these are cross-vendor (provider-level diversity).

skeptic_count.description: Number of skeptics on the panel (== models.length).

findings.description: Surviving findings, most-severe first. Advisory — a human decides what is actionable.

false_positives_suppressed.description: Findings raised by one skeptic and refuted by a majority of the rest. Demoted here (not dropped) for auditability.

id.description: Stable id, deterministic from the reconciled key order (avc-NNN).

severity.description: Most-severe severity among the skeptics that raised it (strict-er wins).

category.description: Defect class: correctness | security | test-coverage | quality | injection | completeness | ...

location.description: file:line (or the closest anchor the skeptic could give).

description.description: What the defect is and why it breaks.

raised_by.description: Model ids that independently raised this finding — the provenance + corroboration signal.

refuted_by.description: Model ids that examined this finding and judged it NOT a defect.

confidence.description: high = corroborated by a panel quorum; medium = corroborated below quorum (or lone raiser on a solo panel); low = single raiser on a multi-skeptic panel.
